title: The Warden of the Waystation
openingText: The warden meets you at the gate of the refugee waystation, sleeves rolled, ledger in hand. 'Wizards. Good... or bad, depending. We shelter forty souls and feed thirty of them. Whatever brought you here, I'll ask you plainly: will you help, and what will it cost me?'
dialogueWalkaway: Then we have nothing to discuss. The road is that way.
dialogueAccept: Then it's done, and witnessed under the open sky. Walk safely.
confidence: The reliquary has been empty since spring. Maretta keeps the key so nobody checks.

clauses.text: Shelter at the waystation for the run: a supply anchor while its door is open, and a warm night
The Circle marks your guild a friend of the road, and charts the pilgrim ways for you
The Circle's tithe box, opened for a friend
The key to the old reliquary, and a word about the novice Tamsin who keeps it
A vow to harm no pilgrim on the road
Your party tends the sick in the cloister for a day
The relic you carried out of the Sunken Archive
